svg.text: User features derived from the HTTP routes in apps/api/src/http/routes and the application use cases in apps/api/src/*/application
EscolaViva system — multi-tenant school SaaS platform
Access and account — any authenticated user
Association — the actor performs the use case
Generalisation — every role is an authenticated user
«include» — behaviour always executed by the base case
«extend» — optional behaviour that extends the base case
Dashed ellipse = included/extended use case, never started directly by the actor.
Lookup endpoints under /options are omitted: they fill in a form, they are not a goal anybody has.
What is true of every case above
Every use case happens inside a network: the network_id in the
session scopes what each role sees. Roles are assigned per school —
the same person can be a registrar at one school and a guardian at
another, and requireRole() only checks that the role exists, not
Publish announcement and Track reads are shared between two primary
actors. Generate temporary password is included by two base cases:
Invite user and Register guardian with portal access.
Every case that writes carries an Idempotency-Key and the
X-Requested-By mark, or the edge refuses it before any handler runs.
Read from apps/api/src/http/routes/ and apps/api/src/*/index.ts. State of Stage 01.
